body_markdown:
**UserGems expands Gem-E for ABM with transparent scoring, ABM campaigns built from Claude and ad audiences that reach the actual buying group**


*A redesigned scoring experience, the new AI Chrome Extension and a new end-to-end walkthrough video bring contact-level ABM for marketing and sales into one motion*


**SAN FRANCISCO, Tuesday November 24th 2026:** UserGems, the AI command center for outbound and ABM, today announced a major update to Gem-E for ABM. The update includes a redesigned scoring experience and the new AI Chrome Extension, both now live for all customers, plus new ad audience integrations and marketing reporting, now in beta. Together they give marketing and sales one shared, contact-level view of which accounts are in market, who inside them to reach, why now and what to do next, then run the campaign across ads and outreach from the tools both teams already use.


A new walkthrough video, *How do you know an account is in market? Transparent ABM scoring with UserGems* , shows the full motion end to end:


Most ABM platforms stop at the account. They flag a company as in market, then leave four questions unanswered: How do you know? Who should we reach? Why now? What do we do next? Sales won't act on a score it can't see inside. Marketing ends up building audiences, ads and handoffs by hand. And neither team can say for sure whether an account actually moved.


Gem-E for ABM answers all four from the UserGems Live Identity Graph of each customer's accounts and contacts, the same live view for marketing, sales and their AI agents.


**What's new in Gem-E for ABM**


- **Scoring that shows its work.** Every account and contact is graded A to D by a model trained on the customer's own wins, not industry averages, and placed in a buying stage. Each score shows the signals behind it. Teams can adjust the weights and add custom signals such as pricing page visits or webinar attendance.
- **People, not just companies.** Person-level intent and website visitor identification, 30+ native buying signals, and custom signals researched by the Gem-E Research Agent show exactly who in the buying group is active.
- **Sales sees who and why, where they already work.** The UserGems AI Chrome Extension brings prioritized contacts, their signals and a reason to engage into Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn, Outreach, Salesloft and Gong. The Gem-E Writing Agent drafts personalized emails and call cheat sheets.
- **ABM campaigns built from Claude or ChatGPT.** With the UserGems MCP, marketers describe the campaign in plain language and Gem-E builds the workflow in UserGems, with branches for ads and sales outreach. Nothing activates until the user approves it.
- **Ads that reach the buying group.** Contact-level audiences sync to LinkedIn, Google, Meta, Bing and AdRoll and update automatically as buyers come into and fall out of signal. Match rates reach up to 95% on LinkedIn, 85% on Google and 70% on Meta.
- **Proof that accounts moved.** Buying Stages dashboards track every account from awareness to decision and tie each touch, ads included, to pipeline, so marketing and sales report from the same numbers.


**What's in the video**


1. The problem: an ABM platform says an account is in market, and the team still has questions.
2. Scoring explains the why: transparent, adjustable A-to-D scoring with custom signals.
3. Sales sees who and why: Gem-E inside the AI Chrome Extension.
4. Marketing runs the coordinated motion: building the ABM workflow from Claude with the UserGems MCP, and contact-level ad audiences with platform match rates.
5. Reporting shows whether the account moved.


**Results customers are seeing**


- **Quickbase** rebuilt outbound around UserGems signals. Comparing average quarterly performance in 2025 with Q1 2026, the team saw 5x lead creation, 3x pipeline opportunities and 2X closed-won revenue. Using the UserGems MCP, the team built two campaigns at once in about three hours one day and an hour the next, work that would normally take three days.
- **Frontify** uses UserGems scoring to decide where its team spends time. Its A-grade accounts convert 3.1x more than its D-grade accounts, and around 40% of its SDR pipeline comes from UserGems campaigns.
- **HubSpot** 's GTM strategy team found that contact-level intent led to 6x more deals than company-level intent.


Most teams are live in three to four weeks, with high-intent accounts surfacing within hours of connecting their data.


"Teams switching off legacy ABM platforms tell us the same thing: they were paying for an account-level dashboard their reps didn't trust," said Trinity Nguyen, CMO of UserGems. "Gem-E for ABM shows you who's in market down to the person, explains exactly why, and lets marketing and sales act on it together, in ads and outreach, from the tools they already use."


"This is everything we've wanted for years, and we didn't know it existed. We replaced Demandbase and picked UserGems" said[Bryn Adler, Senior Director of Marketing at Emburse.](https://www.usergems.com/customers/emburse-bryn-adler)


**Availability**


Gem-E for ABM is available now. Teams moving from[6sense](https://www.usergems.com/usergems-vs-6sense) or[Demandbase](https://www.usergems.com/usergems-vs-demandbase) can see the side-by-side comparisons.
